summary: Bulk Safe Delete Students Bug Fix - Verified and additional fix applied. Backend endpoint POST /api/students/bulk-safe-delete now correctly finds students with role='estudiante' and turno_id=null. Also fixed user creation endpoint to set academic fields for role='estudiante'. Frontend getUserCount now counts both 'student' and 'estudiante' roles.
critical_code_review_comments: Found and fixed additional bug: POST /api/users endpoint only set academic fields (nivel_id, grado_id, seccion_id, turno_id) when role='student', not when role='estudiante'. Fixed by changing condition to check for both roles.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk safe delete endpoint fully tested. Key fixes verified: 1) role filter uses $in: ['student', 'estudiante'], 2) turno_id filter uses $or to include null/missing turno_id, 3) descriptive error messages for different failure scenarios. Additional fix applied: user creation endpoint now sets academic fields for both 'student' and 'estudiante' roles. Frontend getUserCount now correctly counts both role variants.
